rows: A tornado briefly touched down in an open field; no damage was reported.
Nickel hail covered the ground on Highway 84.
Several trees and large branches downed. A large oak tree fell on a house, damaging the roof.
Golfball-size was reported approximately two-and-a-half miles west of Priddy and just south of Democrat.
A tree was blown over County Road 190.
Penny size hail fell in Star.
Estimated winds of 60 mph were reported near CR 141 near the Comanche/Mills county line.
Golfball size hail fell near CR 141 near the Comanche/Mills county line.
Nickel size hail fell in Goldthwaite.
Numerous trees were down just north of Star.
Widespread property and tree damage was reported across the county. Several power outages also occurred.
Golfball size hail fell in Democrat.
Baseball size hail fell in Priddy.
Peak winds of 70 mph were estimated in Priddy. Large tree limbs up to 10 inches in diameter were down and other tree damage was observed.
Roof damage was observed on multiple homes in Priddy.
Nickel size hail fell between the towns of Democrat and Priddy.
Part of the metal roof of a manufactured home on CR 411 south of Goldthwaite was peeled back. The beams were also lifted off with the sheet of metal.
Quarter size hail fell in the town of Priddy.
Quarter size hail fell 9 miles east-northeast of Goldthwaite.
Goldthwaite police officers reported golfball sized hail on highway 183 south of town.
Two large trees were blown down over FM 573 near Mullin.
The combination of 70 mph winds and golfball sized hail resulted in several windows blown out of houses, minor roof damage and several trees blown over near Priddy.
Golfball sized hail fell in Goldthwaite. The hail broke glass windows at the Mills County Courthouse, damaged skylights at the elementary school, and dented cars.
Penny sized hail fell in Star, which is approximately 12 miles east of Goldthwaite.
A house suffered roof damage west of Goldthwaite.
Quarter sized hail fell between Mullin and Zephyr.
The Mills County Emergency Manager and local storm spotters observed a tornado. The tornado occurred in open land and did minimal damage to trees.
Trained spotters reported golf ball sized hail in the city of Priddy.
Trained spotters reported hail to the size of baseballs in the city of Caradan.
The Mills County Emergency Manager observed a tornado to the east and northeast of Priddy. The tornado occurred over open land and produced minimal damage.
Nickel hail was reported 1 mile west of Priddy, near Farm to Market Road 218 and County Road 132.
Golf ball sized hail was reported in, and west of, the city of Priddy.
Mills County sheriff's deputies reported golf ball sized hail approximately four miles south of Goldthwaite.
There were several broadcast media reports of golf ball sized hail near the community of Castor, in Mills County.
The Mills County Sheriff's Office reported quarter sized hail in the city of Goldthwaite.
Quarter-sized hail was reported 6 miles west of Goldthwaite.
A public report estimated 2-inch diameter hail near the intersection of State Highway 16 and County Road 262.
A public report estimated 2-inch diameter hail near the intersection of State Highway 16 and County Road 262.
Broadcast media reported quarter sized hail approximately 11 miles east of the city of Goldthwaite.
Mills County Sheriff's Department reported nickel size hail in the city of Goldthwaite, TX.
Golf ball size hail was reported at Goldthwaite High School.
Mills County Sheriff's Department reported ping pong ball sized hail in the city of Mullin, TX.
Golf ball to 2 hail was reported from south of Goldthwaite east along CR 306. Some windows were broken south of Goldthwaite on Hwy 183.
Baseball sized hail was reported west of Center City.
A social media image indicated golf ball sized hail in eastern Mills County.
Broadcast media reported ping pong ball sized hail just west of Goldthwaite.
A trained spotter reported golf ball size hail in the Goldthwaite area.
Public reported golf ball sized hail around 4 miles south of Goldthwaite.
Amateur radio reported 1 inch hail 1 mile south of Democrat.
